notes: Free, no VIN/login. www.mbusa.com/en/owners/manuals renders a Mercedes 'OOM' web component; its JSON API (https://eu.api.oneweb.mercedes-benz.com/css/oom/{vehicleSlug}, header X-Locale: en-US) returns for each US manual edition the US-English Operator's Manual PDF (www.mbusa.com/css-oom/assets/en-us/pdf/...) plus AMG supplements; page_url = www.mbusa.com/en/owners/manuals/{vehicleSlug}. IMPORTANT: OOM editions are labelled by publication/manufacture date ('Select the manufacture date', e.g. 2025 October), NOT by model year. For these documents 'year' is INFERRED (field year_basis): an edition is assigned to every US model year whose production window (June of MY-1 to June of MY) overlaps the edition's validity (edition date until the next edition of the same body+series), restricted to the US model-year range of that series (e.g. W205 C-Class 2015-2021, W206 2022+); editions without a month are dated June of the given year. Hence one MY usually has 2-3 candidate editions and an edition can appear under two MYs; choose by vehicle build date where known. Exact model-year documents (year_basis 'model year as labelled') come from www.mbusa.com/en/owners/service-warranty-manuals: MY2021 and MY2022 Owner's Manuals and AMG manuals (PDF), MY2019-2020 Quick Start Guides, MY2014-2018 COMAND/Audio multimedia operator's manuals (multi-model, doc_type other), MY2021-2026 Service & Warranty booklets (PC and EQ versions). Bodies included per line where sold in the US: C-Class sedan/coupe/cabriolet; E-Class sedan/wagon/coupe/cabriolet; S-Class sedan (W222/V222, V223 long wheelbase)/coupe/cabriolet; GLC incl. GLK X204 and GLC Coupe; GLE incl. M-Class W166 and GLE Coupe; GLS X166/X167; CLA C117/C118 and electric CLA C174 (2026). Not mapped: C-Class wagon S205 and S-Class short-wheelbase W223 (listed on MBUSA but not US-market bodies), Mercedes-Maybach, AMG GT 2-door, GLC electric X540, EQS SUV. One OOM edition (e-class-wagon-2013-s212-mbux, PDF named ...2013-s213-mbux) has inconsistent metadata and was excluded. GL-Class (X166 GL, MY2014-2016) is absent from the OOM catalog. Verification: all PDFs answered HTTP 206 to Range bytes=0-1023 with body starting %PDF; size = total from Content-Range. The JSON API and /content/dam PDFs were checked with Python httpx; /css-oom/assets PDFs time out for non-browser clients, so they were checked via fetch() from a browser session on mbusa.com.
